lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A well-defined horizontal ridge extends along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity pixel gradient on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a scattered distribution of small, high-luminance blobs with an irregular spatial arrangement compared to the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller teleost fish, identified as remoras, are visible attached to and swimming near the ventral region and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
